title: JUMP: Single-Pass Membership Inference on Fine-Tuned Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2607.16207v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Public open-weight language models are often fine-tuned on private or domain-specific data before deployment, creating a need to audit whether individual records were used during adaptation. We study this problem for discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs), using the pre-fine-tuning checkpoint as a reference. Unlike autoregressive models, dLLMs allow arbitrary mask sets and return predictions for all masked positions in parallel. SAMA averages reconstruction signals over many random masks, which can dilute informative positions and requires repeated model evaluations. We propose JUMP (Joint Uncertainty-Guided Mask Probing), which selects low-reference-confidence positions, masks them jointly, and aggregates clipped target-reference reconstruction gaps from one scoring query per model. translated_title: JUMP：对微调扩散语言模型的单次成员推断
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.16207v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：公开开放权重的语言模型在部署前通常会在私有或领域特定数据上进行微调，这就产生了审计需求，以确定在适配过程中是否使用了特定记录。我们针对离散扩散语言模型（dLLMs）研究这一问题，并以微调前的检查点作为参考。与自回归模型不同，dLLMs允许任意掩码集，并并行返回所有掩码位置的预测。SAMA方法对多个随机掩码的重建信号进行平均，这可能会稀释信息丰富的位置，并需要重复的模型评估。我们提出了JUMP（联合不确定性引导掩码探测），它选择低参考置信度的位置，联合掩码这些位置，并从每个模型的一次评分查询中聚合裁剪后的目标-参考重建差距。在六个MIMIR域中，JUMP在LLaDA-8B-Base上将平均ROC-AUC从0.819提升到0.902，在Dream-v0-Base-7B上从0.851提升到0.942，同时使用的计算量仅为原来的三分之一。
tldr: 本文提出JUMP方法，通过联合掩码低置信度位置并单次评分查询，显著提升了微调扩散语言模型的成员推断准确率，同时大幅降低了计算开销。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes JUMP, which jointly masks low-confidence positions with a single scoring query, significantly improving membership inference accuracy for fine-tuned diffusion language models while greatly reducing computational cost.
